narrative.intro: Mckesson obligated $9.9B in FY2026 to date. Mckesson won 2,028 federal awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $4.9M. Mckesson obligations fell 16.6% year over year. Mckesson has a strong concentration in pharmaceutical and related markets: Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing accounts for $9.9B of obligations. Mckesson receives the vast majority of its federal dollars from one buyer. The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $9.6B to Mckesson in FY2026 to date. Mckesson also received smaller obligations from the Department of Justice, the Department of Health and Human Services, and other agencies. Mckesson fiscal-year obligations have varied since FY21, rising from $7.7B in FY21 to $11.9B in FY25, then falling to $9.9B in FY26 to date. Mckesson contract activity this year is partially complete, so totals reflect fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals.

sections.heading: How large is Mckesson's federal book in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Mckesson obligated $9.9B in FY2026 to date. Mckesson won 2,028 awards with an average award size of $4.9M. Mckesson obligations fell 16.6% year over year. Mckesson fiscal-year totals are partial and reported as fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Who are Mckesson's top federal customers and markets?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is Mckesson's top buyer with $9.6B in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice and the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $146M and $124M respectively. Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing is Mckesson's largest NAICS market with $9.9B in obligations. Mckesson has minor obligations in other markets and agencies, including the Department of Homeland Security at $9.3M and the Peace Corps at $405K.

faq.q: How much does Mckesson make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Mckesson obligated $9.9B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Mckesson won 2,028 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $4.9M. Mckesson obligations fell 16.6% year over year. Mckesson fiscal-year totals are partial and reported as fiscal year to date.

The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer of Mckesson in FY2026 to date, obligating $9.6B. The Department of Justice and the Department of Health and Human Services follow at $146M and $124M respectively. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $9.3M, the Peace Corps obligated $405K, and the Department of State shows $0 in obligations.

faq.q: What does Mckesson sell to the government?
faq.a: Mckesson sells primarily pharmaceutical-related products and services to the government. Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing is the largest market for Mckesson with $9.9B in obligations in FY2026 to date. Mckesson also has obligations in drugs and druggists' sundries wholesaling and several medical-related manufacturing and services NAICS categories.
